project_type: Next.js 16 CFA exam prep app with localStorage-based state
verification_instructions: 1. Run bun run tsc --noEmit (must exit 0). 2. Run bun run vitest --run (env.test.ts has pre-existing zod v4 failures - ignore those). 3. Confirm no new errors.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no external npm installs. All packages already installed. Use bun at /root/.local/share/mise/shims/bun.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders. No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/). No useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads - use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer. No router.push() during render phase. No TODOs or placeholders.
key_patterns: loadAllQuestions() in src/features/question-bank/utils/question-loader.ts combines sample + imported questions. PracticeAttempt data stored in localStorage under 'cfa-buddy-attempts' key. Seed functions in seed-*.ts create rich module-level data. Flashcard SM-2 system in features/flashcards/utils/sm2.ts with storage.ts. CFA_SUBJECTS_ORDERED and CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS in src/shared/config/subjects.ts.
directory_structure: src/features/{name}/components|types|utils|hooks|data - feature-based architecture. src/shared/ has analytics, config, hooks, components, lib, types. src/app/ has Next.js pages. Question data in src/features/question-bank/data/ (5 subject files + sample-questions.ts).
